technique_name: Describe the different stages in the software development lifecycle.
description: The software development lifecycle consists of five stages: planning, requirements gathering and analysis, design, implementation and testing, and deployment. The planning phase begins with an analysis of the business case, user needs and budget allocation. The requirements gathering and analysis phase is where the goals and requirements of the project are identified.
